intent.tagline: Read the point where the agent asks
intent.narration: The agent asks a question and waits. Today the reader is silent there. With this change, the pane shows the question at once, a reading fills in beside it, and the person answers in the pane.

problem_solution.problem: An AskUserQuestion call stops the agent until the person answers, but no Stop fires. The reader stays silent where the person needs a reading most, and the engine dialog shows the question alone.
problem_solution.solution: A hook holds the call, the pane shows the question card, and Send answers the call. A probe runs first, and the dialog is the fallback.
problem_solution.narration: The hook never answers alone. Only the person's Send, or the fallback dialog, releases the agent.

beats.text: No Stop fires at an AskUserQuestion call.
Hold the call, and answer it from the pane.
A hook budget may cut off the wait, so a probe runs first.

alternatives.rejected_because: It can only allow, ask, or deny a call. It cannot answer one.

alternatives.option: Refuse the call, so the agent asks in its reply and ends its turn
alternatives.rejected_because: The engineer wants the pane to be the only place that shows the question.

alternatives.option: Read the point after the answer, in PostToolUse
alternatives.rejected_because: The reading would come after the person decided.

alternatives.option: Let priority-dev find the open question in the transcript
alternatives.rejected_because: The transcript may lag behind the hook. The call input already holds the questions.

alternatives.option: Show the questions only when the reading arrives
alternatives.rejected_because: The agent waits during two model calls. The person can answer from the call input at once.
The reader reads main-loop stops only.

architecture.narration: One new hook in the same module catches the call. priority-dev gets an open-question input, and the plugin still calls it only as a process.

beats.text: ADR-0045: the plugin never imports priority-dev.
ADR-0051: the reader reads main-loop stops only.
